messages.subject: continuation of unite() issues
parts:
Dear Altuna,

 

This is a continuation from my initial question posed on July 28, 2014

 

I believe I installed the development (was not entirely sure what that meant) version with the following commands:

 

install.packages( c("data.table","devtools"))

source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")

biocLite(c("GenomicRanges","IRanges"))

library(devtools)

library(methylKit)

install_github("methylKit", username = "al2na",build_vignettes=FALSE)

 

After reading the methylation profiles and looking at the file I have:

 

chr     start       end strand coverage numCs numTs

1 chr10 100004267 100004267      +       11    11     0

2 chr10 100004513 100004513      +       20    18     2

3 chr10 100004961 100004961      -       20    18     2

4 chr10 100005282 100005282      +       21     6    15

5 chr10 100006682 100006682      +       19     3    16

6 chr10 100007185 100007185      -       18    17     1

 

Then I performed meth=unite(myobj, destrand=FALSE) and received  a new error message:

 

Error in merge.data.table(df, df2, by = c("chr", "start", "end", "strand"),  :

  Elements listed in `by` must be valid column names in x and y

 

Please let me know if I installed the development version correctly and if so, why I am now getting a new error message.

 

BW,

Michelle

Here is how to install the development version:

library(devtools)
install_github("methylKit", username = "al2na",ref = "development",build_vignettes=FALSE)
